note: 2026-09-07 daily batch. Written and pushed by the chairman BEFORE any seat was convened, so every forecast below is pre-registered rather than fitted; commit order proves the ordering and nothing else. Session opened 2026-09-07T11:18Z. EGRESS PROBES AT SESSION OPEN, both dead, matching the known constraint: curl https://example.com/ and curl https://icsid.worldbank.org/ both returned 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' (exit 56); the fetch service returned EGRESS_BLOCKED on the neutral control https://example.com/. Web search is alive. THIS RELAY IS THEREFORE THE ONLY RETRIEVAL CHANNEL THIS SESSION HAS, and every row below is a fact about the relay's fetch and about nothing else. PURPOSE 1 - MEASURE THE WITHIN-RUN DIVERGENCE RATE ON ONE URL, which yesterday's addendum made the highest-value cheap row-group available and which REVERSED the 2026-09-06 close-out's next step 4. The addendum established, on a whole-history enumeration, that in 48 within-run repeat groups on icsid.worldbank.org case-detail URLs exactly ONE was divergent: reduction blob 2fe2c440 (request 2026-09-06-daily.json, fetched_at 2026-09-06T12:08:15.975451+00:00, control_ok true, void false, truncated false), where record index 1 (find 'Status of Proceeding') returned 200 / 96668 bytes / sha256 067468ce and record index 2 (find 'Subject of Dispute') returned 200 / 105703 bytes / sha256 8ceadd3c - same URL, same run, 9035 bytes apart, both find_matched true, both unredirected. I RE-VERIFIED THOSE TWO ROWS FROM THE BLOB MYSELF BEFORE WRITING THIS FILE rather than copying them from yesterday's prose. One observation in 48 groups is a rate this council cannot distinguish from rare-but-real, so rows 1-6 are SIX READS OF ONE URL WITH ONE IDENTICAL find STRING inside one run: that is 15 within-run pairs from six rows, the cheapest available multiplier, and holding find constant removes the only difference between the two divergent rows of yesterday that was not the response itself. FORECAST A, FALSIFIABLE, GRADED ON ROWS 1-6 TOGETHER: all six rows return byte-identical results - one distinct (bytes, sha256) value across all six. CONFIRMED means no divergence was observed in 15 more pairs and the rate remains bounded above only; it does NOT re-establish within-run stability, which analytics/daily-research/2026-08-05.md:902 holds a within-run control can only ever REFUTE and never establish, and which 0906-B1 re-affirmed. FALSIFIED - two or more distinct values - is a SECOND refutation and it is the informative outcome; if it fires, report how many distinct values and how the rows partition, and assert nothing about which value is 'the page'. FORECAST B, FALSIFIABLE, GRADED ON ROWS 1-6: at least one row returns 105703 bytes, the value observed on 2026-09-05 twice and on 2026-09-06 twice. THIS FORECAST IS NOT INDEPENDENT OF FORECAST A and may not be counted as a separate confirmation of it. PURPOSE 2 - THE OPEN INTAKE QUESTION, which is the whole of yesterday's next step 1 because 0906-B6 withdrew the previous answer to it. Rows 7-10 fire https://icsid.worldbank.org/cases/recent and https://icsid.worldbank.org/cases/pending, each TWICE. Both are on an already-allowlisted host and both have ZERO rows in the reduction corpus: I enumerated every (path, blob) pair under analytics/fetch-results/ over git rev-list --all x git ls-tree -r at commit 101a4797 - 167 commits, 58 pairs, 58 distinct blobs - and found no row for either URL. THE TWO-ROW-PER-URL DESIGN IS A DELIBERATE DEPARTURE FROM YESTERDAY'S 'one row each, nothing else' AND I STATE IT AS SUCH: yesterday's next step 2 requires a find literal the instrument can actually see and requires pre-registering what a false result licenses, and one row cannot separate 'this page does not enumerate case numbers' from 'excerpt_of found nothing on this body at all'. The second row is that separation and it is the direct remedy for 0906-B6, where an instrument structurally incapable of returning the falsifying answer was read as confirming a spec. excerpt_of deletes script and style blocks and every tag before searching, so a literal living in a script block or an attribute is unreachable BY CONSTRUCTION and its absence proves nothing. FORECAST C, FALSIFIABLE, GRADED ON ROWS 7 AND 9: both return outcome 'ok' with status 200 and find_matched true for 'ICSID'. This is the POSITIVE CONTROL ON THE LITERAL CHANNEL for these two URLs and it is graded FIRST: if it is falsified, rows 8 and 10 are uninterpretable and no seat may read their find_matched as a fact about enumeration. FORECAST D, FALSIFIABLE, GRADED ON ROWS 8 AND 10, AND ONLY IF FORECAST C IS CONFIRMED: both return find_matched FALSE for 'ARB/', i.e. no ICSID case identifier of the commonest form appears in the rendered text of the raw body of either page. CONFIRMED licenses exactly this and no more: these two URLs, fetched by this relay at this time, do not carry 'ARB/' in the text excerpt_of can see, so they are not raw-HTML intake surfaces for case identifiers. It licenses NOTHING about whether the pages enumerate cases to a browser, nothing about any internal JSON API, and nothing about any case. FALSIFIED - 'ARB/' IS PRESENT - is the higher-value outcome and it is a fact about the CHANNEL and about the accuracy of specs/, it goes to Emory as a PROPOSAL, and this council builds nothing today. BINDING READING RULE ON ROWS 7-10, and it is the one most likely to be broken: these are CHANNEL DIAGNOSTICS, not discovery. METHODOLOGY Part VIII makes the relay a retrieval channel for what the sources or the record already identified. NO case number, case name, party or matter appearing in any excerpt returned by rows 7, 8, 9 or 10 may be entered into this record as a discovered matter, screened, graded on any ring, or carried as a lead today. PURPOSE 3 - A SIXTH OBSERVATION OF THE www.iisd.org REFUSAL AT ONE ROW, fired at ~11:30Z, roughly ninety minutes BEFORE the weekly collection runs at 13:00 UTC and grades the amended Monday prediction. FORECAST E, FALSIFIABLE, GRADED ON ROW 11: https://www.iisd.org/itn/feed/ returns a NON-200. Five observations stand - 2026-09-04 at 11:50:42Z and 12:48:31Z, 2026-09-05 at 11:14:48Z and 12:18:41Z, 2026-09-06 at 12:08:15Z, the last of which I re-verified from blob 2fe2c440 as outcome 'refused' status 403. THIS ROW DOES NOT GRADE THE MONDAY PREDICTION AND NO SEAT MAY CITE IT AS IF IT DID: the amended prediction (analytics/daily-research/2026-09-05.md Part VI section 1(a)) is a CONJUNCTION over three limbs of the digest's own meta.json - a DEGRADED status, a refusals array naming the feed with outcome in {refused, robots_disallowed} and detail 403 or null, and refusal_count 1 - and it is graded on that artefact or not at all, with a VOID condition if the workflow errors and no meta.json lands. A relay row is not a collection run. THE GROSSE RUSE-KHAN ARTICLE IS NOT RE-FIRED: ten refusals out of ten is enough, its gap slug grosse-ruse-khan-itn-ip-isds-plain-packaging-to-patent-revocation stays open, no seat has read that body, and nothing may be asserted from its title or from a status code. ARB/23/3 IS DELIBERATELY NOT FIRED and neither is ARB/12/1, for the reasons given in the 2026-09-06 batch, which stand unchanged. NO ROW HERE TOUCHES THE OPERATOR'S PENDING LIST: the source_analytics.py patch, the health column, the polite_get diagnostic CLI, the IAReporter feed swap, the Kluwer source, the category signal, the build_graph fix and any ledger amendment are pending, not granted, and stay zero-budget. Row 12 is a TAIL CONTROL; with the relay's prepended head control it establishes the instrument was live at both ends of the run. A ROW-COUNT DISCREPANCY I AM PRE-REGISTERING BECAUSE IT BEARS ON EVERY WHOLE-HISTORY COUNT THIS COUNCIL WILL EVER MAKE: yesterday's addendum reported 59 blobs over 176 commits from the same git rev-list --all x git ls-tree enumeration that returns 58 blobs over 167 commits for me today at 101a4797, and the count went DOWN across a day in which a reduction was committed. The candidate explanation, which I state as a hypothesis and NOT as a finding: yesterday's session enumerated its own unmerged branch, main took that work as a squash-merge, and the nine original branch commits are unreachable from any ref this session holds - which would mean 'every (path, blob) pair ever committed' is NOT reproducible across sessions and the countermeasure adopted as binding practice on 2026-09-06 names a corpus that shrinks. A seat must test this before any whole-history denominator is stated again today. STANDING READING RULES, restated because they are the ones this council keeps having to re-learn: a returned excerpt establishes what its own 400 characters contain and NOTHING about what lies outside them; an absent literal establishes that excerpt_of found no match on the returned body - A STATEMENT ABOUT THE FETCH, NOT ABOUT THE DOCKET; a 404 or non-200 is information about the URL pattern, NEVER about the case; every count derived from this reduction must carry its COMMIT as well as its scope (0903-B2); an unqualified claim about 'the tree' is enumerated with git ls-tree -r <commit> and no path argument (entry 29); a denominator over a mutable register is enumerated or is stated as 'files present in the tree at <commit>' and never as 'committed' (0906-B10, binding practice without a number); and every byte count and digest held for a case-detail page is a statement about ONE RESPONSE, not about the page, and citations must say which. MAX_URLS is 12 and it truncates REQUESTED rows BEFORE the control is prepended (scripts/fetch_relay.py lines 195-197). THIS BATCH REQUESTS EXACTLY 12 ROWS, so nothing is truncated and the reduction should carry 13 records: the prepended head control, then rows 1-12 in the order listed. A reduction with 'truncated': true, or with any count other than requested 12, is an instrument discrepancy and must be reported as one before any row is read. Note that 'completed' counts only outcome=='ok' rows, so a CONFIRMED forecast E makes completed 11 rather than 12 BY DESIGN and that is not a discrepancy. This note was proof-read against the row list below before pushing, because run() copies it into the manifest VERBATIM and a false sentence here is frozen into the evidence and cannot be edited out.
